name: Village of Pleasantville
gaps: PUD has no fixed yards, lot size per house or coverage; set by Planning Commission site plan (§ 185-25).
RRR/RR/R side yards: no combined minimum stated; one side must be 32 ft when there is no garage.
FAR schedule (§ 185-49.1) interpolates FAR; bands use straight-line GFA between listed lot sizes (differs from lot x interpolated FAR by under ~10 sf).
R-PO section was amended 2-25-2026 (L.L. 3-2026) but the Schedule III attachment on eCode360 is dated 2005; bulk numbers may have changed.
No local steep-slope or tree-removal chapter found in the Village Code chapter list.
County layer lists R-1 minimum lot as 8,000 sf; the code's Schedule I says 7,500 sf (code value used).

wetlands.summary: Ch. 182: in a Wetland Control District, buildings, filling, removal of material or drainage within 50 ft of a wetland, water body or watercourse need Village Engineer or Planning Commission approval.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 153: stormwater review and SWPPP for land development disturbing 1 acre or more (or part of a larger common plan).

adu.summary: §§ 185-31 to 185-35: one accessory apartment per one-family lot by special use permit, owner-occupied, inside part of the house at least 10 years old, min 250 sf and max 25% of the dwelling's floor area, max 2 bedrooms, not in garage space.

general.accessory_structures: Garages, sheds and similar accessory structures: at least 60 ft from the front lot line and 5 ft from side/rear lot lines, max 1 story / 15 ft, no habitation (each residence district's accessory-use clause).
general.pools: Pools and sport courts need a lot of at least 20,000 sf, 20 ft from every property line, not nearer the street than the rear wall of the house (side wall on a corner lot's side street); 6.5 ft hedge or fence screening and a 4-6.5 ft safety fence.
general.notes: Fences max 4 ft in front yards and 6.5 ft in side/rear yards. Planning Commission may halve lot frontage on culs-de-sac.

RRR.name: One-Family Residence RRR

max_floor_area.note: § 185-49.1 Residential FAR schedule (R-1, R, RR, RRR): FAR 0.48 at 7,000 sf falling to 0.25 at 22,000 sf+, interpolated between listed lot sizes; bands interpolate the listed max GFA (within ~5 sf of lot x interpolated FAR). Lots under 7,500 sf are exempt.

accessory.notes: Garages, sheds, garden houses etc.: not nearer than 60 ft to the front lot line or 5 ft to side/rear lot lines, max 1 story / 15 ft, no habitation (district accessory-use clause, e.g. § 185-8B(2)).

RRR.source: § 185-36, Schedule I Bulk Requirements, Residence Districts RRR, RR, R, R-1, R-2 and R-2A (Attachment 1, amended L.L. 8-2022); § 185-49.1
RRR.notes: One side yard must be 32 ft if the house has no garage (20 ft with a garage) (Schedule I note 1); corner lots 32 ft without a garage. Height 2.5 stories or 30 ft, whichever is more restrictive. Min floor area 1,200 sf.

Planning Commission may raise coverage/development coverage/FAR to 30%/60%/0.40 only for non-dwelling or multi-unit columns on older buildings (note 5).

RO-2.notes: Side yards: 8 ft each, 20 ft combined with a garage; without a garage the combined side yards must be 32 ft with one at least 20 ft; corner lots without a garage need a 20 ft side yard (notes 2-3). One-family values are the R-2 column per Schedule IV note 1. Multiple dwellings: 10,000 sf lot, 20 ft from street, 15 ft from property lines, 3 stories / 35 ft, 40% coverage.

PUD.name: Residential Planned Unit Development
PUD.notes: 25 contiguous acres minimum (15 acres within a C-O District). Lot sizes, frontage, coverage and building locations are set by the Planning Commission on the PUD plan; density capped at the underlying zoning yield. Height 2.5 stories / 30 ft unless the Planning Commission allows more.
